history.summary: Documented as 'Maa Kali Temple' in Railway Colony, Jagdalpur, in directory listings (onefivenine lists it 0.4 km from the Railway Colony reference point) and as a mapped place listing at 19.069207, 82.017657. It is a neighbourhood Kali shrine; no dedicated history page, founding date or builder is documented online, so its age is recorded as unknown. CSV name correction: the temple is documented as 'Maa Kali Temple', not the generic 'Kali Temple'.

name: Maa Kali Temple
town_description: Jagdalpur is the district headquarters of Bastar district in Chhattisgarh and the main gateway to the Bastar region's waterfalls, caves and tribal culture. It is home to the former Bastar Palace and the famous 75-day Bastar Dussehra festival.

travel.airport: Jagdalpur Airport (JGB) has limited connectivity; the main gateway is Swami Vivekananda Airport, Raipur (~300 km)
travel.road: Jagdalpur is connected by road on NH 63 to Raipur (~300 km) and to the Odisha coast

visitor_information.opening_hours: Not documented; small neighbourhood temples are typically open morning and evening
